content:
```yaml
participants:
  - el_type: ethrex
    el_image: ethpandaops/ethrex:focil-devnet-0
    cl_type: consensoor
    cl_image: ethpandaops/consensoor:main
    count: 2
network_params:
  preset: mainnet
  slot_duration_ms: 12000
  gloas_fork_epoch: 1
  heze_fork_epoch: 2
  eip8198_fork_epoch: 3
  slot_duration_schedule:
    - epoch: 3
      slot_duration_ms: 10000
ethereum_genesis_generator_params:
  image: ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator:fix-slot-schedule-passthrough
dora_params:
  image: ethpandaops/dora:bbusa-eip8198-slot-schedule
additional_services:
  - dora
  - spamoor
```

you can run this with: `kurtosis run github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package@feat/eip8198-shorter-slots --args-file above.yaml`
